headline: Pure creatine monohydrate for cellular energy optimization
body: Optimize your training metrics with third-party tested creatine monohydrate. Full ingredient transparency with zero proprietary blends.
rationale: This persona treats her body like a system and values evidence over price. The copy targets her systematic approach by focusing on cellular energy, scientific naming (creatine monohydrate), and ingredient transparency while avoiding any mention of discounts since her price sensitivity is low.
